LESSON: LISTENING FOR GIST

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.1: Listening for Gist
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening for Gist, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 7 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: where do you live? )أين تسكن؟ ( What is your friend’s name?
